connector.name: Openfoodfacts MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Barcode lookup, nutrition search, and product comparison for 3M+ crowd-sourced food products.
connector.summary: Hosted at openfoodfacts.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package openfoodfacts-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OFF_BASE_URL
env.description: Open Food Facts API base URL override. Useful for testing against a mock server.

env.name: OFF_RATE_LIMIT_PRODUCT
env.description: Product read rate limit (requests/min). Matches the 15 req/min/IP Open Food Facts documents for product reads.

env.name: OFF_RATE_LIMIT_TAXONOMY
env.description: Taxonomy resolution rate limit (requests/min). Applies to the live tag-vocabulary lookups off_browse_taxonomy makes; a spent budget falls back to the offline sample rather than failing.

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
